card.1.desc: Discard the <greenColor>GREEN</greenColor> <greenIcon /> card with the <bold>HIGHEST</bold> value.
card.2.desc: Discard this card if <bold>ANOTHER</bold> <greenColor>GREEN</greenColor> <greenIcon /> card is in play.
card.3.desc: Discard this card if a <yellowColor>YELLOW</yellowColor> <yellowIcon /> card is in play.
card.4.desc: Discard this card if a <redColor>RED</redColor> <redIcon /> card is in play.
card.5.desc: Discard this card if a <blueColor>BLUE</blueColor> <blueIcon /> card is in play.
card.6.desc: Discard this card if <bold>IT IS</bold> the card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value in play.
card.7.desc: Discard this card if it is the <bold>ONLY</bold> <greenColor>GREEN</greenColor> <greenIcon /> card in play.
card.8.desc: Discard the <greenColor>GREEN</greenColor> <greenIcon /> card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value.
card.9.desc: Discard the <yellowColor>YELLOW</yellowColor> <yellowIcon /> card with the <bold>HIGHEST</bold> value.
card.10.desc: Discard this card if a <blueColor>“THE ABSOLUTE” (30 to 35)</blueColor> card is in play.
card.11.desc: Discard this card if it is the <bold>ONLY</bold> <yellowColor>YELLOW</yellowColor> <yellowIcon /> card in play.
card.12.desc:
This card can <bold>NEVER</bold> be discarded, unless it wins the bout.

<precision>Ignore any effect that asks you to discard “Fear”, as it is always recovered by its owner at the end of the bout.
The only way to discard “Fear” is to win the bout with it.</precision>
card.13.desc:
If this card is discarded, discard a card from your hand.

<precision>If you end up with 0 cards in hand at the end of a bout due to “Luck”’s effect, you win the round for your team, even if other players end the same bout with 1 card in hand.
“Fear” cannot be discarded using “Luck”’s effect.</precision>
card.14.desc:
The card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value wins the bout.

<precision>This card changes the bout’s win condition from the highest-value card to the lowest-value card. The lowest-value card is discarded as the winner.
Ignore the effect of “Sadness” if it is played during the same bout as “Mirror”, since the highest-value card cannot win anyway.</precision>
card.15.desc:
Everyone must, if possible, play a card <bold>LOWER</bold> or <bold>HIGHER</bold> than <bold>15</bold> (your choice).

<precision>If you don’t have a card in your hand that allows you to respect the constraint of “Law” when it is played, you may play the card of your choice as normal.</precision>
card.16.desc: Discard the <yellowColor>YELLOW</yellowColor> <yellowIcon /> card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value.
card.18.desc: Discard the <redColor>RED</redColor> <redIcon /> card with the <bold>HIGHEST</bold> value.
card.19.desc: Discard this card if it is the <bold>ONLY</bold> <redColor>RED</redColor> <redIcon /> card in play.
card.20.desc: Discard the card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value.
card.21.desc:
You <bold>CAN</bold> play this card in front of another player. If you do, that player must play a card in front of you.

<precision>If you play “Dream” in front of yourself, it has no effect. Otherwise, it must be played in front of someone who has not yet played a card this bout.
That player must immediately place a card from their hand in front of you.
If it is a card with a <lightning /> <bold>effect</bold>, apply that effect immediately.</precision>
card.22.desc: The player to your left starts the next bout.
card.23.desc:
Exchange <bold>THIS CARD</bold> with another card <bold>ALREADY</bold> in play.

<precision>If the card you take in exchange has a <lightning /> <bold>effect</bold>, do not apply its effect a second time (the card is considered played already).</precision>
card.24.desc: The player of your choice shows you a card <bold>OR</bold> show a card to the player of your choice.
card.25.desc: Discard the <redColor>RED</redColor> <redIcon /> card with the <bold>LOWEST</bold> value.
card.26.desc:
The card with the <bold>HIGHEST</bold> value <bold>CANNOT</bold> win the bout.

<precision>Ignore the highest-value card when determining who wins this bout.
The second-highest card played wins.</precision>
card.28.desc:
Return any card in front of another player to their hand. That player must play <bold>ANOTHER</bold> card.

<precision>If the card returned to the other player’s hand is “Law”, the constraint set by “Law” no longer applies for the rest of the bout.
If the new card played has a <lightning /> <bold>effect</bold>, it applies immediately.</precision>
card.29.desc:
Exchange a card from <bold>YOUR HAND</bold> with a card <bold>ALREADY</bold> in play.

<precision>After you play this card in front of yourself, take into your hand a card that another player has already played this bout. Then play a card from your hand in front of that person. They then resolve the card’s <lightning /> <bold>effect</bold>, if it has one.
If the card you took is “Law”, its constraint no longer applies for the rest of the bout.</precision>
card.absolute.desc:
Exchange a card from <bold>YOUR HAND</bold> with the player of your choice.

<precision>Exchange the cards simultaneously and secretly.
Place them face-down on the table, then each player takes the other’s card.</precision>
help.arcane.precision.1: You must always apply a card’s effect.
help.arcane.precision.2: If you cannot apply an effect, you can still play the card, but its effect does nothing.
help.arcane.precision.3: <lightning /> <bold>effects</bold> are resolved immediately when you play the card.
help.arcane.precision.4: A <lightning /> <bold>effect</bold> must always be fully resolved before the next player puts their card down.
help.arcane.precision.5: The term “IN PLAY” refers to all cards placed in front of the players.
help.arcane.important:
<redColor>IMPORTANT:</redColor> Cards with an <hourglass /> <bold>effect</bold> are all resolved at the end of the bout, simultaneously. Even if an effect asks you to discard a card, <bold>the discarded card’s</bold> <hourglass /> <bold>effect is still</bold> applied.
All cards that are discarded by effects are discarded at the same time as the winning card.
log.win.turn: {player}’s <arcane /> card is discarded as it wins the bout.
log.secret-for-other: {player} asks to see a card from {target}.
log.the-law.less: Players must play, if possible, a card <bold>LOWER</bold> than 15.
log.the-law.more: Players must play, if possible, a card <bold>HIGHER</bold> than 15.
tuto.goal: Presages is played in teams. You must get rid of your cards until you have <bold>only one left in your hand</bold>.
tuto.start: At the start of the game, each player receives a <bold>The Absolute</bold> card. Teams are determined by these cards: the player who received the highest-value The Absolute teams up with the player who received the lowest-value one.
tuto.mate:
So you are teamed up with Lisa Williams. The <moon/> and <star/> symbols in the player panels are a reminder of the teams.
Click <bold>Validate</bold> in the header to start the game.
tuto.hand: Each player received 4 cards in addition to their The Absolute card. This is your hand of 5 cards.
tuto.absolute:
On your turn, you must play a card in front of you.
For example, play your The Absolute card.
tuto.immediate:
Some cards have an immediate effect: <lightning/>.
The Absolute allows you to exchange a card with another player.
tuto.absolute.effect: Give this card to your partner.
tuto.absolute.effect.opponent:
Your partner gave you this card in exchange.
It is now up to the player on your left to play a card.
tuto.life:
Cards have a color, as certain effects only apply to cards of a certain color.
For example, <bold>Life</bold> discards the highest-value green card at the end of the bout.
tuto.trigger.end: The bout continues in this way until each player has a card in front of them.
tuto.win.turn:
The player with the highest-value card wins the bout. Their card is discarded.
Here, that is you, thanks to the <bold>The Absolute</bold> card.
tuto.death:
All end-of-bout effects are also applied simultaneously: <hourglass/>.
Here, <bold>Life</bold> and <bold>Death</bold> discard each other.
tuto.take.inhand: Players whose card was not discarded take it back into their hand.
tuto.new.round: A new bout begins. The player who won the previous bout plays first.
tuto.help: To learn what the cards do, you can click on them at any time.
tuto.win.round:
The round continues in this way until one of the players has <bold>only one card left in hand</bold>: their team then wins the round.
<italic>If several players finish with a single card in hand at the same time, the one who kept the highest-value card wins the round.</italic>
tuto.2winround:
The first team to win 2 rounds wins the game.
It is your turn now (because you won the previous bout): may the Presages be with you!
